test_deferred_target: test the deferred.Deferred class wraps a target module and returns it via the target property
test_deferred_lazy_computation: test deferred.Deferred computes the target module only once regardless of repeated access
test_deferred_attr_forwarding: test deferred.Deferred forwards attribute access to the target module after construction
test_deferred_setattr: test deferred.Deferred sets attributes on the target module and reflects changes bidirectionally
test_deferred_alternative_forward: test deferred.Deferred uses alternative call_methods like forward instead of __call__
